sources.entry: Claudoscope - Tool for browsing and analyzing Claude Code sessions. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/cordwainersmith/claudoscope) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Claudoscope - Menu bar app for Claude Code session analytics with real-time secret detection, config health linting, and token/cost tracking.

summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app and dashboard for browsing, analyzing, cost-tracking, and security-checking local Claude Code and Claude Cowork sessions.
summary.what_it_does: Claudoscope reads Claude Code session files from ~/.claude/projects/ and Claude Cowork sessions from the Claude desktop app, using FSEvents to pick up changes and a local SQLite index for fast startup. It provides a menu bar popover with today's session count, tokens, estimated cost, and a sparkline, plus a full dashboard with session chat views, per-file edit diffs, a Trace timeline with replay, token and cache analytics, and a Fleet board of live sessions. It includes opt-in session notifications and cost alerts based on Claude Code hooks, and real-time plus full-history secret scanning for ten credential patterns. Its Health section runs 72 lint rules over Claude Code configuration, plus a Hardening baseline installer for ~/.claude/ with drift detection and a Canon per-project decision-record feature. It also offers an optional read-only MCP server so Claude Code can query your usage data. The README states everything runs locally with no telemetry, though it notes network calls for update checks.
use_cases: Reviewing what Claude Code did in past sessions
Tracking Claude Code token usage and estimated API cost
Detecting leaked credentials in session transcripts
Auditing and hardening Claude Code permissions and hooks
Getting notified when Claude Code needs input or spend passes a limit
Viewing per-file diffs of edits Claude made
how_to_run: Download Claudoscope.dmg from the Releases page and drag the app to Applications (manual install)
stack: Swift/macOS native app (implied by macOS menu bar app)
notable: Secret scanning across session history with real-time alerts for ten credential patterns
One-click Hardening baseline for ~/.claude/ with backup, revert, and drift detection
Trace tab with time-axis session replay and PNG share card without transcript text
Cost estimation covering Anthropic API and Vertex AI pricing tables, with Cowork spend included
Canon: per-project committed records of engineering decisions shown in the dashboard
caveats: Requires macOS 14.0 or later on Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are not supported
Requires Claude Code to have been used at least once so session data exists
Cost figures are estimates from published API pricing, not actual billing data
